_about: Budgets for scripts/token_budget.py, in local-estimate tokens. 'max' gates --check; 'target' is advisory and only reported. null means no limit. Override a max with --budget ID=N. Raise a max deliberately, in this file, when new text earns its place.

metadata.why: Agent Skills overview: Level 1 metadata costs about 100 tokens per skill and sits in context on every turn while the skill is enabled.

activation.why: max: regression ceiling just above the current size, so growth is a deliberate decision. Raised from 5500 in Phase 4C, from 5600 in the communication-quality recovery (see docs/communication-recovery.md §4), and from 5900 in the communication-experience upgrade to pay for one-idea paragraphs, glanceable tables, core-then-optional hierarchy, architecture-diagram cues, complementary figure/table/prose jobs, five-beat examples, and semantic-icon navigation (see docs/communication-experience-upgrade.md §2); activation is 6085 legacy / 6124 heuristic, which is the first time activation exceeds the Phase 4 baseline (5946 / 5966). Those rules are owner-set and stay in SKILL.md because an on-demand reference would drop them when unread (Phase 4B Option B). target: the Agent Skills overview puts Level 2 instructions under 5k tokens, and Claude Code re-attaches only the first 5,000 tokens of an invoked skill after auto-compaction.

ref:explanation-examples.md.why: On demand. The overview states bundled files cost nothing until read.

persistent:project-instructions.why: Opt-in standing guidance, paid on every turn of every chat in the Project.

persistent:claude-md.why: Opt-in standing guidance, loaded in full at every Claude Code session launch.
